title: Forward reference to namespaced type with same name breaks with TypedDict

labels.name: false-positive
labels.description: mypy gave an error on correct code

body:
* Are you reporting a bug, or opening a feature request?

I am reporting a bug

* Please insert below the code you are checking with mypy,
  or a mock-up repro if the source is private. We would appreciate
  if you try to simplify your case to a minimal repro.

```
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Union, Any
from typing_extensions import TypedDict


class T(TypedDict):
    b: b.T


class b:
    T = Union[Any]
```

* What is the actual behavior/output?

```
failure2.py:7: error: Name 'b.T' is not defined
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 1 source file)
```
* What is the behavior/output you expect? 

No type error

* What are the versions of mypy and Python you are using?
  Do you see the same issue after installing mypy from Git master?

Python 3.7.3, mypy 0.750. I get the same results after installing mypy from Git master.

* What are the mypy flags you are using? (For example --strict-optional)

No particular flag.

* If mypy crashed with a traceback, please paste
  the full traceback below.

No crash

Additional notes:
The following examples *do* typecheck properly:
* Name the type differently:
```
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Union, Any
from typing_extensions import TypedDict


class T(TypedDict):
    b: b.U


class b:
    U = Union[Any]
```
* Without TypedDict:
```
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Union, Any


class T:
    b: b.T


class b:
    T = Union[Any]
```
* Without forward reference:
```
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Union, Any
from typing_extensions import TypedDict


class b:
    T = Union[Any]


class T(TypedDict):
    b: b.T
```
